exploit_name: Incorrect bit mask clears EMAs and lock mode during oracle rebase
description: UPPER_118BITS_MASK is 130 bits instead of 138 bits, inadvertently clearing portions of the 88-bit EMA field and 2-bit lockMode during rebasing.
root_cause: UPPER_118BITS_MASK is 130 bits instead of 138 bits, inadvertently clearing portions of the 88-bit EMA field and 2-bit lockMode during rebasing.
fix_description: Extend mask to 138 bits to correctly preserve all upper fields.
notes: EMAs and lockMode data corrupted during oracle pack updates, compromising solvency checks.
